title: The Gift of the Magi
summary: A poor young couple each sell their most loved possession to buy a Christmas present for the other.

source.author: O. Henry
source.note: Retold from the plot in new B1 English by Lexkite; no sentences copied from the original text.

cover.scene: Flat 2D illustration: a young woman with short hair and a young man in a small warm apartment at Christmas, a wrapped gift between them, no text

chapters.title: Two Treasures
sentences: Della counted her money three times, but the total was still only one dollar and eighty-seven cents.
Tomorrow was Christmas, and she wanted to buy a perfect present for her husband, Jim.
The couple were very poor, and they lived in a tiny flat with almost no furniture.
Still, each of them owned one treasure that they were proud of.
Jim had a gold watch that had once belonged to his father and his grandfather.
Della had long, brown hair that fell almost to her knees and shone like a waterfall.
She stood by the window for a while and cried quietly.
Then she wiped her face, put on her old coat, and hurried out of the door.
In a small shop, a woman agreed to buy her hair for twenty dollars.
Della did not hesitate, and the scissors did their work in a few minutes.
She searched the shops for hours and finally found a simple gold chain for Jim's watch.
It cost twenty-one dollars, and she paid for it with a smile.

quiz.q: Why was Della sad at the start of the story?
options: She had too little money for a present.
She could not find her husband.
quiz.explain: She counted her money and found she had only a little.
A woman agreed to buy her long hair.

quiz.q: What did Della buy for Jim?
quiz.explain: She found a gold chain for his watch.

chapters.title: The Surprise
sentences: That evening Della waited nervously for Jim to come home.
She hoped that he would still think she was pretty without her long hair.
When he opened the door, he stopped and stared at her without saying a word.
His face showed neither anger nor disgust, only a strange, deep surprise.
Della ran to him and explained that she had sold her hair to buy him a gift.
"Don't worry about it," Jim said softly, "I love you just the same."
Then he took a small package from his pocket and put it on the table.
Inside the paper, Della found a set of beautiful combs for her hair.
She had wanted them for a long time, but she had never been able to afford them.
Now her hair was too short to wear them.
Jim laughed gently and told her that he had sold his watch to pay for them.
The two of them sat together in silence, and they both understood how much they loved each other.

quiz.q: How did Jim react when he saw Della?
quiz.explain: His face showed a deep surprise, not anger.

quiz.q: What did Jim buy for Della?
quiz.explain: He gave her a set of combs.
He sold his watch to pay for the combs.
